infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: CoachOS needs access to your calendar to sync approved lessons with your device calendar.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: CoachOS needs access to your reminders to help you stay on top of your coaching schedule.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CoachOS requires camera access to allow coaches and athletes to record training sessions and upload profile videos.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: CoachOS accesses your contacts to easily invite your clients, athletes, and team members to your coaching portal.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CoachOS uses your location to map out local running routes, tracking outdoor athletic performance accurately.
